critical.issue: whisper_transition_trim=0 silently becomes 15. Setting the trim to 0 (admin explicitly wants no overlap-zone trim) round-trips as 15. RCA: settings_service.py line 62 in get_public_settings: `int(s.get('whisper_transition_trim') or 15)` — the `or 15` triggers on falsy 0. Same bug at line 117 (get_whisper_config) and line 127 (get_whisper_transition_trim). Fix: replace `(s.get('whisper_transition_trim') or 15)` with `(s.get('whisper_transition_trim') if s.get('whisper_transition_trim') is not None else 15)` in all three places. Repro: PATCH {whisper_transition_trim: 0} → response shows 15 immediately. This means the trim subtraction in analysis_service._maybe_transcribe_tracks and server.py transcribe_one_track will use 15s even when admin wants 0s.

action_items: FIX settings_service.py `or 15` falsy bug in 3 locations (lines 62, 117, 127). Replace `int(s.get('whisper_transition_trim') or 15)` with explicit None check so trim=0 persists correctly. Without this fix, admins cannot disable transition-trim — setting to 0 silently reverts to 15s and Whisper still skips the last 15 seconds of every track.

OPTIONAL: pre-existing test_analysis.py infra issue — `/tmp/real_audio.mp3` is missing in the test env, causing 3 setup errors + 1 cascading failure (`pytest.analysis_mix_id` undefined). Not from iter13, but worth fixing in test_analysis.py setUp by skipping or generating a fixture audio file.
critical_code_review_comments: settings_service.py uses the `value or default` pattern in 3 places for whisper_transition_trim — this collapses the legitimate value 0 into the default. Use `value if value is not None else default` instead. This is the primary bug this iteration.

server.py:712-718 transcribe_one_track derives `clean_end = max(start, next_start - trim)` and then `duration = max(5.0, min(clean_end - start, 480.0))` — if clean_end == start (track shorter than trim), duration is clamped to MIN 5.0, meaning Whisper still transcribes 5s of the overlap zone. Consider returning 400 early if clean_end - start < 5 to avoid wasting Whisper compute on garbage.

frontend/src/pages/AdminSettings.jsx:97-100 — `if (!Number.isFinite(patch.whisper_transition_trim) || patch.whisper_transition_trim < 0) patch.whisper_transition_trim = 15;` correctly handles invalid input client-side, but allows trim=0 through which gets eaten by the backend bug. Once backend is fixed this client guard is fine.

Mic icon click handler in CueTrackList.jsx:30-45 — stopPropagation verified working. Disabled state during transcribe blocks other mics with `pointer-events-none + opacity-30`. Good UX. Consider adding a confirm dialog when this becomes more expensive (multi-minute Whisper runs on long tracks).

transcribe_one_track endpoint has no rate-limit or 'already transcribing' guard. An admin clicking 10 mic icons fast would queue 10 concurrent Whisper requests against the local GPU. Consider an in-memory dedupe map (mix_id, track_index) → asyncio.Lock.

rca of the issue: settings_service.py:62 `'whisper_transition_trim': int(s.get('whisper_transition_trim') or 15)` — Python truthiness: 0 or 15 == 15. Same pattern at line 117 (get_whisper_config) and 127 (get_whisper_transition_trim). PATCH stores 0 correctly in Mongo (update_settings does `update[k] = v` without falsy filter), but every read collapses 0 → 15. So even if the DB has the user's choice of 0, every consumer (UI, analysis_service, transcribe endpoint) reads 15. Fix in 3 lines: `int(s.get('whisper_transition_trim')) if s.get('whisper_transition_trim') is not None else 15`. Frontend AdminSettings.jsx will then show 0 correctly, and analysis_service._maybe_transcribe_tracks + server.py transcribe_one_track will honor trim=0 (full-track transcription). Reproduction: `curl -X PATCH .../api/admin/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $T' -d '{"whisper_transition_trim":0}'` → response `{"whisper_transition_trim":15,...}`.
